newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle trade at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle trade at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said.

Inquiry and demand moderate. Asking prices mostly $66.00 per cwt, bids mostly $64.50-$65.00. Last sales Thursday at $65.00. Feedlots were current. Sales confirmed this week on 133,000 head including 41,800 head or about 31 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - none last week - 900 last year - 17,600
